Use snake_case for variable and function names.

Use CamelCase for class names.

Follow PEP 8 style guidelines.

Include type hints for function parameters and return types.

Write docstrings for all public modules, classes, functions, and methods.

Organize imports into three groups: standard libraries, third-party, and local.

Apply Black for automatic code formatting.

Use Flake8 for linting to detect style errors.

Follow SOLID principles and Clean Code practices.

Use the logging module instead of print() for logging.

Practice TDD with pytest and measure test coverage.

Avoid anti-patterns documented in The Little Book of Python Anti-Patterns.

Handle exceptions using appropriate try-except blocks.

Follow security best practices and use static analysis tools for security vulnerabilities.

Implement the dependency inversion principle through dependency injection.

Design clear and concise interfaces to increase internal module cohesion.

Promote code reuse through appropriate design patterns and modular components.

Encourage clear and accessible technical documentation to facilitate system maintenance and scalability.
